summary.text: Jordan Pace is a Republican business executive who has represented District 117 in the South Carolina House of Representatives since November 14, 2022, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Jordan Pace was born in Spartanburg, South Carolina.
Pace graduated from James F. Byrnes High School in 2007 and earned a B.A. in political science and religion from Charleston Southern University in 2011.
His career experience includes work as director of outside tenant relations with Grescon Development, a high school teacher with Northwood Academy, and a real estate agent with BIG Realty LLC.
Pace succeeded Krystle Matthews as the District 117 representative.

In 2023-2024 he chaired the House Ethics Committee and was first vice chair of the House Judiciary Committee, and for 2025-2026 he is assigned to the Medical, Military, Public and Municipal Affairs Committee.
